_meta.note: All keys mirror schemas.ts stable IDs. Diagnostic templates use mustache-style {var} placeholders matched to gate-diagnostic.failures[].vars.

diagnostic.SPEC_EDIT_INPUT_REQUIRED: non-interactive `loaf spec edit` requires --input <src>; the editor lane requires TTY stdin and stdout
diagnostic.SPEC_LOCKED_NO_DIRECT_EDIT: {kind} blocked: spec_locked=true; use `loaf finding raise --category spec-gap --action amend-spec` to back-edge into SPEC.spec
diagnostic.SPEC_NOT_INITIALIZED: {kind} blocked: spec_version=0; run `loaf spec submit` first to bump spec_version to 1
diagnostic.SPEC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED: spec.md already exists at {spec_md_path}; refusing to overwrite
diagnostic.CONFIG_ALREADY_INITIALIZED: loaf config already exists at {config_path}; refusing to overwrite
diagnostic.FINDING_TARGET_REQUIRED: finding action={action} target validation failed ({reason}): task_id={task_id}, step={step}
diagnostic.PRUNE_RESTORE_NOT_FOUND: no trashed session matches the given id
diagnostic.PRUNE_RESTORE_AMBIGUOUS: the session id was trashed more than once; pass --at <ts> to pick one
diagnostic.PRUNE_RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: the trash bucket is incomplete (missing a required artifact); not restoring
diagnostic.PRUNE_PATH_OCCUPIED: a restore destination already exists; refusing to overwrite
diagnostic.PRUNE_PARTIAL_FAILURE: prune partially failed: one or more sessions could not be removed
diagnostic.MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_FLAGS: mutually exclusive flags in the same invocation: {flags}
diagnostic.HOOK_EVENT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: hook event `{event}` is not implemented in this loaf version (Phase 16 SC-15{sub_cycle} pending; see protocol §11)
diagnostic.MISSING_VERIFIABILITY: REQ {req_id} must declare measurable, verified_by_scenarios[], or acceptance_na+reason
diagnostic.DRIVES_NOT_BOUND: REQ {req_id} is not referenced by any task.drives[]
diagnostic.MUTATION_OUT_OF_RIGHTS: event:tasks_amended on task {task_id} is not permitted at sub_state {sub_state} — §8.6 grants no mutation right for this change
diagnostic.FEATURE_NOT_FOUND: no feature found in cwd (.loaf/ is empty or missing, or no projection has phase != DONE)
diagnostic.FEATURE_AMBIGUOUS: current working directory has {count} active features and no dispatch context: {feature_list}
diagnostic.SESSION_CWD_MISMATCH: --session {uuid} is registered against cwd={registered_cwd}, but the current cwd is {current_cwd}
diagnostic.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: --session {uuid_or_prefix} matches no entry in the registry
diagnostic.PENDING_BLOCKS_ADVANCE: pending head {pending_id} (kind={kind}) blocks `loaf advance` until resolved
diagnostic.GATE_NOT_PENDING: `loaf gate decide {gate_kind}` requires pending head kind=gate_decision; current head kind: {head_kind}
diagnostic.ESCALATION_NOT_PENDING: `loaf profile escalate --confirm --input <ceremony.json>` requires pending head kind=profile_escalation; current head: {actual_head}
diagnostic.EXECUTE_DONE_TASKS_NOT_FINAL: cannot advance EXECUTE.work → EXECUTE.done: {count} task(s) are not in a final status (done or abandoned); finish their remaining steps or abandon out-of-scope tasks with `loaf tasks abandon <T-N> --reason "..."`
diagnostic.NO_SESSION: no session at {feature_dir} — run `loaf start <feature>` first
diagnostic.OPEN_FINDINGS_PRESENT: verify-accept check 2: {count} actionable finding(s) still open (ids={open_ids}); resolve or close before verify-accept
diagnostic.COVERAGE_NOT_SATISFIED: {covered_id} has no evidence that satisfies it (canSatisfy failed for all candidates)
diagnostic.DELIVER_NOT_ACCEPTED: deliver requires verify_accepted=true at sub_state={sub_state}; run `loaf gate decide verify-accept --approve` first
diagnostic.DELIVER_SETTLE_PHASE_BYPASS: deliver from VERIFY.accept requires ceremony.settle_phase=false (standard); deep ceremony must run `loaf settle` first
diagnostic.DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_UNAVAILABLE: verify-min was unavailable in this build (ceremony_label={ceremony_label}) — superseded at v0.1.1 by DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_INCOMPLETE; no longer emitted
diagnostic.DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_INCOMPLETE: verify-min: {count} done task(s) lack required evidence to deliver (ceremony_label={ceremony_label}); add evidence or waive, then re-deliver
diagnostic.DELIVER_SPIKE_TASKS: cannot deliver: task {task_id} is kind=spike (status={status}); spike tasks block delivery for the entire session
diagnostic.SETTLE_NOT_ACCEPTED: VERIFY.accept → SETTLE.lessons requires verify_accepted=true; run `loaf gate decide verify-accept --approve` before `loaf settle`
diagnostic.SPEC_LOCK_NOT_SATISFIED: SPEC.design → EXECUTE.plan requires spec_locked=true; run `loaf gate decide spec-lock --approve` before `loaf advance EXECUTE.plan`
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_CLAIMABLE: task {task_id} cannot be claimed (status={status} — terminal state)
diagnostic.TASK_DEPS_NOT_SATISFIED: task {task_id} cannot be claimed: dependency {blocking_dep} is not done (status={blocking_status})
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_CLAIMED: task {task_id} step {step} mutation requires task.status=in_progress (got status={status}); claim the task first
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_ABANDONABLE: task {task_id} cannot be abandoned (status={status} — already in a final status)
diagnostic.TASK_ABANDON_BLOCKED_DEPENDENTS: task {task_id} cannot be abandoned: non-terminal task(s) {blocking_dependents} depend on it; abandon or complete the dependents first
diagnostic.SESSION_REASON_REQUIRED: {kind}: --reason is required (the session-terminal entry must record why)
diagnostic.PROJECTION_WRITE_FAILED: {projection} projection write failed after journal append at last_seq={last_seq} (spec_version={spec_version}): {error}
diagnostic.FINDING_AMEND_SPEC_NOT_LOCKED: finding raise action=amend-spec requires state.spec_locked=true; spec is not locked at sub_state={current_sub_state}, edit directly via `loaf spec submit / add-*`
diagnostic.SPEC_VERSION_BATCH_MISMATCH: {kind}: spec_version must be {current_spec_version} at batch_index={batch_index}, got {payload_spec_version}
diagnostic.TASK_COMPLETE_PRECONDITION_VIOLATED: task {task_id} is not complete (status={status}); must-applicable steps not terminal-positive: {blocking_steps}
diagnostic.CANONICAL_TASK_BODY_UNAVAILABLE: task {task_id} is in the projection but has no canonical body in the journal (migration-imported); a whole-task amend cannot be reconstructed
diagnostic.BUG_TASK_REQUIRES_RED: behavioral bug task {task_id} cannot start or complete its implement step before its RED test is registered
diagnostic.BUG_TASK_FLAG_MISUSE: task {task_id}: red_test_registered=true is valid only on a red-step task_step_done for a behavioral bug task (passed/waived result) — not on this entry
diagnostic.BUG_TASK_RED_NOT_REGISTERED: behavioral bug task {task_id} is done but never registered its RED test (red_test_registered≠true)
diagnostic.SPIKE_CONVERT_NO_SPIKE_TASK: cannot convert: the session has no non-abandoned spike task; `loaf spike convert` is a spike-task exit (protocol §8.3)
diagnostic.SNAPSHOT_STALE_REBUILD_REQUIRED: snapshot stale (reason={reason}) at {feature_dir}; run `loaf doctor --rebuild --feature <feature>` to re-serialize from journal truth
diagnostic.JOURNAL_TAIL_REQUIRES_NEWER_LOAF: tail recovery refused at seq {seq}: journal kind {kind} uses entry schema {entry_schema_version} ({reason})
diagnostic.DOCTOR_MODE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: requested loaf doctor mode is not implemented in this release
diagnostic.DOCTOR_REBUILD_MIGRATED_UNSUPPORTED: doctor --rebuild does not support v0.0.x-migrated journals in this release
diagnostic.ACTUAL_SCOPE_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE: actual scope history is incomplete: EXECUTE closure transition(s) at seq {transition_seqs} have no same-batch scope:recorded marker
diagnostic.WRITE_PATH_VIOLATION: write blocked: `{normalized_path}` is outside the allowed write paths for sub_state `{sub_state}`
diagnostic.PROTECTED_FILE_WRITE: write blocked: `{normalized_path}` matches protected_files entry `{matched_deny}` — protected files are never writable

sessions_list.selector_conflict: sessions list does not accept {conflicting} — it lists across all sessions; use --in-cwd to filter

tui.selector_conflict: tui does not accept {conflicting} — it lists across all sessions; selectors are nonsensical for an interactive UI
tui.interactive_only: tui is interactive-only; use `loaf sessions list --format json` for scriptable session output

hook.missing_event: loaf hook requires an event token; one of: {events}. Run `loaf hook --list-events` for the full enum
hook.unknown_event: unknown hook event '{event}'; expected one of: {allowed}. Did you mean '{suggestion}'?
hook.write_path_missing:
write-side hook requires --path

or a non-TTY stdin hook payload (tool_input.file_path)

check.selector_conflict: check does not accept {conflicting} — it validates a file by path, independent of any feature session
check.kind_required: `{subject}` is not a file path. To validate a {kind} artifact, pass its path: `{suggestion}` (noun-first `loaf {kind} check` is reserved for a future release)
check.kind_invalid: --kind '{value}' is not recognized; expected one of {allowed_kinds_human}

schema.selector_conflict: {subject} does not accept {conflicting} — schema dumps are feature-agnostic

dispatch.session_feature_dir_conflict: {conflicting} cannot be combined with --feature-dir (session identity comes from registry; manual featureDir is contradictory)
dispatch.feature_dir_requires_feature: --feature-dir requires --feature <name> or $LOAF_FEATURE to name the feature

handoff.pack_validation_failed: ResumePack failed runtime validation (builder bug or schema drift)

tasks_add.empty_array: tasks add input is an empty array

journal.kind_invalid: --kind must be a registered journal kind (got {value})
journal.actor_invalid: --actor must be a non-empty actor prefix or full actor string

evidence.covers_invalid: --covers must be a valid coverage id (got {value})
evidence.task_invalid: --task must be a valid task id (got {value})

deliver.next: session complete — `loaf start <feature>` to begin another

doctor.rebuild_state_change_one: doctor rebuild: rebuilt {count} projection file for {feature}
doctor.rebuild_state_change_many: doctor rebuild: rebuilt {count} projection files for {feature}

spec.submit_text: spec submitted v{spec_version}: {req_count} req / {scen_count} scen / {vis_count} vis

tasks.list_empty: no tasks in projection (run `loaf tasks submit` first)

journal.list_row_batch: seq={seq} entry_id={entry_id} at={at} actor={actor} kind={kind} batch_id={batch_id} batch_index={batch_index} batch_count={batch_count}

evidence.list_row: id={id} kind={kind} covers={covers} task={task_id} at={at} actor={actor}
evidence.compatibility_warning: evidence kind {kind} cannot satisfy {covered_id}; use one of: {allowed_kinds} (entry written)

verify_status.lane_reason_no_done_tasks: no done tasks require run verification
verify_status.lane_reason_no_review_obligations: no non-NA requirements or done tasks require review verification
verify_status.lane_reason_no_e2e_scenarios: no applicable e2e scenarios require acceptance verification
verify_status.lane_reason_no_visual_contracts: no applicable visual contracts require visual verification

list.title: loaf sessions ({active_count} active / {total_count} total)
list.help: [↑/↓] move · [Enter] detail · [space] fold · [a] active/all · [s] sort · [r] reload · [q] quit

help.start: Begin a new feature session in .loaf/<feature>/
help.status: Print current state.json + artifact health summary
help.next: Compute the next owner command for the current session
help.advance: Run next transition + diff guard (git status + write_paths AND-merge)
help.resume: Resume session from a handoff pack
help.handoff: Write resume-pack.json for context overflow handoff
help.spec_submit: Validate spec.md against SpecFrontmatter schema and record (strict).
help.spec_init: Scaffold a spec.md template ready for $EDITOR
help.tasks_submit: Validate tasks.json against discriminated-union TaskKind schema
help.tasks_register_red: Register failing test for a behavioral-bug task (required before implement)
help.evidence_add: Append a new evidence entry; auto-assign EV-id
help.waive: Record a waiver evidence; actor must start with human: and reason must be >=10 chars
help.finding_raise: Raise a finding (VERIFY.* always, EXECUTE.* only post-spec-lock)
help.verify_status: Compute current verify check applicability + status (real-time, never reads reconcile.json)
help.gate_decide: Record human gate decision; writes evidence kind=gate-decision
help.amend: Edit spec or tasks pre-lock (rejected post-lock; use findings instead)
help.deliver: Close session as DONE.delivered (advisory only; no git/gh side effects)
help.check: Schema-only check for a given artifact or path (CI usage)
help.doctor: Self-diagnose loaf-cli installation, repo layout, config
